svg.title: Proof. Fix a marked slot qj. The triangle inequality gives P i dist(address(qj), address(qi)) ≤ (n + 1)S(y, q) and dist(y, address(qj)) ≤S(y, q). Split e−aS = e−aS/2e−aS/2; the first factor is at most the connecting weight of width a/[2(n+1)] from the marked slot and the second is at most e−(a/2) dist(y,address(qj)). The counting estimate P y e−b dist(z,y) ≤c(b), proved below at (US2), sums the anchors. At order zero there is no marked slot, and no volume-independent bound for the total scalar action is asserted.
